messages.text: Hi good moring ,am not sure if you can help.But was able to collect my p2 last week Friday it up on running am running it at normal mode  doing 2  to 3 th/s and 22jth  am new to mining just trying to get the most efficient setting

Morning — nice, glad it's up and hashing.

The P2 is rated 10 TH/s, so 2–3 TH/s on normal mode is low. In Harlo OS, check the preset under settings and your intake temp — a hot or tight spot throttles it fast.

Where's it sitting, and what preset does Harlo OS show?
am using thor os would that matter ?

It can, yes — the presets and tuning curves differ between firmwares, so "normal" isn't the same number on each.

I don't want to guess at Thor OS specifics and have you flash something wrong. Let me get our hardware guy on it — he answers the tuning questions properly.
Handed to the team · Firmware-specific tuning/preset question on Thor OS I can't answer from product

JD has it — he's the one who answers the hardware here. Stay in the chat if you can and he'll jump in; if you step away, you'll get it by email.

One thing that'll help him: is it hashing 2–3 TH/s from the moment it boots, or does it start higher and drop off after a few minutes?
it started at 6

That's the useful detail — starting at 6 and settling at 2–3 usually points to heat, not firmware. The chip tails back as the intake warms up.

Worth checking before JD gets here: is it in an open room or a cupboard/enclosed spot, and is anything blocking the fan intake?
no  its in my office

Good, open room rules out the worst of it.

Then JD will want the chip temp it settles at — Thor OS shows it on the dashboard next to the hashrate. That number tells him straight away whether it's throttling or the firmware preset holding it down.

Can you read it off while it's running?
yes hashrate 3.03 effici 22.4 powerdraw 68.2 v12 470 mhz tep40.4

That settles it — 40.4°C is cool, so nothing's throttling. It's just sitting at 470 MHz and 68 W, which is a low preset, not a fault.

I won't hand you clock and voltage numbers off the top of my head on Thor OS — wrong ones can cook a chip. JD has all of this now and he'll give you the exact step-up.
okay thank you
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: you said you're new to mining — what made the Thor P2 the one you started with?

Well I started with the bitaxe Gamma 1.2 then move up 1.5 and 1.8 then like any hobby i stated getting hock i cane acrose you page been loking at for awhile then check out some of your vidoeos on you tube ,when i saw the p2 ad i just wanted to try something bigger

That's a proper ladder — three Gammas and then you wanted a step up.

You said you were on the page a while before you bought. What held you up on the P2 before you pulled the trigger?
no as soon i i saw the ad for the p2 i had the money so i said that would be a good also from the videos that i saw on you tube
Last one: what was it in those videos that convinced you — someone running one, the numbers, the build?
The hashrate and when it is compair to other the same size it was leading in most categories

That's useful, thanks for walking me through it.

JD's got your numbers and he'll get that P2 up off 470 MHz for you right here.
okay great
Hang tight here and he'll be with you. Enjoy the P2.
